title: There's a 13th sign?!
old_caption:
Episode one: a glittery newcomer crashes the zodiac's group photo and claims to be the 13th sign. Saturn has some gentle facts.
New and exciting isn't always true. Charm isn't the same as character.

title: Gemini has a twin?!
old_caption: A breakup text that doesn't sound like them at all? Before spiralling, ask. A quick check can save a lot of heartache. Assumptions are rarely as accurate as a simple question.

title: one ear on. i’m listening. promise.
old_caption: Aquarius isn't cold, it's buffering. Needing a little space when things get loud is okay. The real closeness is letting your person in anyway, one ear at a time.

title: you want my story? okay. i'll go first.
old_caption: Aries goes first, not to rush, but so you don't have to be scared. Its biggest fear is being too much. Love that shows up early and learns to wait is a gift.

title: Cancer
old_caption: Cancer's shell isn't there to keep you out. It's there because it feels everything. And when it loves you, it remembers the small things. Be gentle with the people who notice you.

title: you’re two minutes late. …kidding. mostly.
old_caption: Capricorn works hard because rest can feel like waiting to be judged. If that sounds familiar, here's your reminder: you don't have to earn a slow Friday. Rest is already yours.

title: hi! hi. we're— i'm— hi.
old_caption: Gemini isn't two-faced. It's two-hearted: the chatty one and the thoughtful one. Its quiet fear is being boring. Love it well by making room for both sides.

title: is my light okay? okay. roll it.
old_caption:
Behind the sign: Leo admits the spotlight is warm, but it can feel lonely up there. What matters most is people seeing the heart, not the hair.
Cheer for the Leos you love, then stay after the show.

title: myth or sky first? …you pick.
old_caption:
Behind the sign: Libra isn't indecisive, it's afraid of choosing wrong. That fear comes from caring about fairness.
Be patient with the Libras in your life. When they choose you, choose them back.

title: sorry, i was somewhere else. …okay. here.
old_caption: Pisces daydreams because real life was loud. That softness is a strength, not a flaw. Its quiet wish is simple: find the ones you love, tie a cord, and don't let go.
